description: A tall lattice drill mast stands on a rocky, treeless shore beside a dark lake, with a small single-engine floatplane moored at the water's edge. A canvas tent with a glowing lantern sits to the right, and in the foreground an open wooden crate holds rows of grey cylindrical drill core samples, with loose rock scattered around. The sky is heavy with dark storm clouds over a low brown tundra. No people are visible, and there is no visible text, signature, or frame.
